quarterly_data.quarter: NVIDIA press release: European Ecosystem Builds World's Most Efficient AI (10-21-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: NVIDIA (release): NVIDIA DSX reference designs pair 100% liquid-cooled Vera Rubin infrastructure (coolant up to 45 degrees Celsius) with dry coolers to cut facility cooling water to near zero, which NVIDIA says could save 54 million liters a day at 2-gigawatt scale; DSX MaxLPS software lets operators generate the same tokens with up to 30% less power (CoreWeave, Firmus, Google Cloud, IREN, Lambda, Nebius, Nscale and Sharon AI are exploring it; a Lambda proof of concept showed 24% more token throughput and an Nscale evaluation 49% higher inference throughput within fixed power budgets), and DSX Flex lets AI factories act as flexible grid loads. Under the DSX Ready program, Trane Technologies' LiquidStack GigaModular and Vertiv's 2.3-megawatt CoolChip coolant distribution units and Hitachi Energy's battery energy storage system have qualified; Schneider Electric has developed power and cooling reference designs for Vera Rubin, and Trane has published three 250-megawatt DSX-based cooling reference designs.
quarterly_data.figure: up to 30% less power for the same tokens; 54 million liters of water a day saved at 2-gigawatt scale
